segments.text: The leader of a religious cult called "Taiyou" ("The Order of the Sun" in English version) inside the Jail which claims that "Some day, the Sun God will burn down the ceiling and we'll be able to leave this place." While she is known by the name of "Oohime" in the cult, she still calls herself by her real name, Michiru. She always talks mysteriously, like a real divine being.

The protagonist. A boy who spends his days as an inmate in Jail. He’s a little timid, but also has a strong side. He is a kind-hearted soul who occasionally tries to protect his friends by throwing his own life on the line.

He’s taken by Akazukin, who came to save Alice, to break out of jail. As support for the Chishiki Girls Squad, girls who fight while wounded and wish to become women of power, they attempt to escape Jail.
Although, he’ll later also obtain a blood-type (Chishiki) ability and be discovered a “Chishiki Boy”…

A calm guy who is a member of the religious cult "Taiyou". He is loyal towards the cult's leader Michiru and is always next to her, explaining the things she says to others. Hitsuka also works as a security guard who guards off-limited areas and ensures that nobody enters them.

One of the few blacksmiths in Prison who makes weapons for the Chishiki Squad. While he has a bad attitude with an equally bad mouth and loves taking breaks, he also likes giving Jack and the girls advise sometimes.

A doctor who is regarded as everyone's older sister. She keeps up a clinic called Rescue Center in which the Chishiki Girls can purify themselves from blood, decrease their madness gauge and get their wounds treated. She is always ready to listen and give advice to anyone in need of. She's also fond of working with the professor on his research of the Jail.
A researcher living in the Jail, he is more knowledgeable of the place than any of the other people in there.

Nickname "Otsuu", one of the Chishiski Girls who is a member of Daybreak and the protagonist of the second game. When she and Ningyohime were younger, Tsuu promised to become the "little mermaid's true prince", and thus, has always acted like a prince. Tsuu is very courageous, though underneath her shell she also has a slightly weak and girlish personality that contrasts her boyish appearance.
She is also the only one who can understand and interact with Jack.

A beautiful girl who values others' happiness more than her own and works hard to make sure the people around her happy. Though she has both a gentle personality and way of speaking, Ningyohime has a stubborn side to her as well. She is madly in love with Tsuu who told Ningyohime she'll be her "prince" when they were younger.

cast.characterName: ナイトメア・ジャック
cast.originalCharacterName: ナイトメア・ジャック

segments.text: After sacrificing himself in order to save Little Mermaid and almost dying, Jack's body got covered in vines, which transformed him into his current state. Despite his current appearance and his intelligence dropping down an infant's level, he still retains his kindness, which helps him support the Chishiki Girls during battles.
Jack's childhood friend whom she was stuck together in a cell with until they were saved by Tsuu. Along their escape way however, Alice's abilities as a Chishiki Girl awakened.
She loves Jack and such, is greatly concerned over him turning into a nightmare so she often tries to talk to him, even if he possibly doesn't understand what Alice is telling him.
The youngest and most energetic girl of the squad. During her first meeting with Ningyohime she mistakes her for emergency rations and fish and attempts to gnaw her.
Her pure energy and honesty lifts the other members' spirits up and keeps them motivated and positive.

The eldest of the three girls who are members of the religious cult "Taiyou". She used to be a member of the Daybreak but after a certain incident with Taiyou, she returns to it with her younger sisters Sleeping Beauty and Snow White.

After reuniting with Tsuu's squad she instantly starts suspecting them, and because of her sudden change in personality both of her younger sisters are worried about Thumbeline so they fight often. She's so obsessed with keeping her sisters safe that it's begun to push them away.

The youngest of the three sisters who are members of the religious cult "Taiyou". She wants to be of help to her sisters and do her best as one of the Hitsukas (aides of the leader) but as Nemu has a hard time speaking up, nothing really goes her way.
Due to her aimless manners, there are many scenes where she bewilders both
Ningyohime and Tsuu but she also extends a hand when they are troubled. Through her interactions with friends, she begins to think about who she really is.

The first-discovered Chishiki Girl whom Daybreak discovered. Due to this she acts like an older sister towards the other Chishiki Girls, even if her hotblooded nature sometimes ends up doing more damage than good.

The middle of the three sisters who are members of the religious cult "Taiyou". She is a very kind girl, but due to her slightly timid nature she ends up in getting trouble with the other members of the cult who misunderstand her.

She trusts her older sister Thumbelina, but tends to get into fights with her often because of their contrasting personalities and due to Snow White often not knowing what to say in front of Thumbelina without angering her.

A Chishiki Girl who was lost but then found. She has a carefree personality but can be quite firm when it comes to the other Chishiki Girls, and rides a big vehicle called "Bamboo No. 1" both when she moves and fights, rarely moving her body on her own. She quickly responds to both words "useless" and "inactive" quite negatively and fast.
A Chishiki Girl Tsuu's squad met at an underground cave. Though she's tremendously strong Hamelin can be quite clumsy at times.

At first she called herself the "Devil Lord" as she kept defeating stronger and stronger Märchen in the underground cave, but when she joined Tsuu's squad she started calling herself the Great Hero Hamelin.

A Chishiki Girl living in a cell area together with her brother Hansel. A very curious and intelligent girl, she loves researching the environment and people around her, but what doesn’t interest her is met with a lack of emotion. She has a habit of speaking without moral views.
She keeps a close eye on her teammates, inspecting each of their actions during their travels and also having fun. Gretel also loves teasing Hamelin.
A Chishiki Girl who went missing when she was younger. Some suspect she's the culprit behind a mysterious murder…
A girl Tsuu's squad met while exploring the cell area. She sells the girls different kinds of tools and weapons.
A girl whom Tsuu's squad found while investigating the underground caverns. She has the ability to instantly lighten up the atmosphere around her. She is also childhood friends with Mamoru.
She is often found at the rescue center where she tends to the survivors and the Märchens working under Hameln.

Hikari's childhood friend whom Tsuu's squad also found while investigating the underground caverns. Though his eyes give an aggressive first impression, Mamoru is a kind and thoughtful boy who gets along with everyone, and becomes an important to ally to Tsuu's squad. He is usually found guarding the base as the gatekeeper, and supports the Blood Maidens as a handyman of sorts.
He is also the protagonist for the prequel novel.

The gatekeeper guarding the entrance to the Liberated District. His kind face is always smiling, but there’s a strange sense of pressure in his expression. Despite being a normal human, he's strong enough to hold off Märchens.

A girl found during Outsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. She's a bit of a spitfire who's quick to pick fights, but is also very reliable and supports the Blood Maidens at their time of need.
She is often found at the store where she sells a variety of goods. She can't seem to stop pestering Itsuki, constantly teasing him as if he was a kid.
A young man found during Otsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. Though not as strong as the others, he makes up for it with his intelligence, analyzing tense situations for solutions.
He is often found at the laboratory, and is constantly conducting research on the Blood Maidens and the Jail. He is a long time friend of Kaede, who still, to this day, treats him like a kid.

A young man found during Outsuu's exploration in the underground caverns. Somewhat of a narcissist and eccentric, he likes changing speech patterns for some reason. In fact, he changes his way of speech so often that it's hard to tell what his true personality is like.
He is often found at the factory where he crafts and strengthens the Blood Maidens' weapons. He acquired this skill after his tenure working at Dawn's factory.
